note: Companion of lyrics.calibrated.ca.json. Times live there only. jp: one slot per calibrated syllable, space separated. '~' = same glyph as the slot before. '_' = ghost syllable (none in this song). Glyphs are the kana the raw file writes, no kanji added. A long-vowel mark is its own glyph on its own syllable (ホ ー ム). A sokuon and a moraic n are own glyphs on their own syllables (っ, ん). Quotes are plain. en: [fromSyl,toSyl(excl),text,'~'?] phrases in English reading order, '~' = loose split, a syllable may have no phrase. skip = raw lines (1-based) that are not sung by this singer. ig = raw text not in the calibration. The English raw file with the same line numbers as the Japanese one is lyrics.raw.en.aligned.txt: it is lyrics.raw.en.txt without its first two lines (header '### English translation by 25239x' and a blank line). Footnote marker [1] on the moon line is ig.
